# One USD transaction whose two CAD splits were entered at different rates.
#
# A transaction stated in a foreign currency is priced through its splits on
# base-currency accounts: their CAD over the foreign currency they are worth.
# Here the revenue says 140.00 CAD for 100.00 USD — 1.4 — and the fee says
# 10.00 CAD for 8.00 USD, which is 1.25.
#
# What this fixture produces: the book imports — it is balanced and
# well-formed, and refusing it would be refusing a book GnuCash holds happily
# — and the basis costs 150.00 over 108.00, the aggregate, whichever CAD
# split is read first. No verdict is passed on the two figures: the same
# shape arises from rounding alone (see fx_usd_invoice_with_tax.txt), and
# nothing in the rounded amounts separates the two cases. Rates run forward
# into figures; the figures do not run back into rates.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "100 USD in, with a CAD fee converted at another rate"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "100.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD -8.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-8.00"
	Income:Sales -140.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "-100.00"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 10.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "8.00"
